item.text:
In ResStock 2025 Release 1:

- **49% of housing units** are in one-story buildings—the stock saturation for option “1” under **Geometry Stories**.
- **Data source:** U.S. Energy Information Administration’s **2009 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**.
- **Basements are excluded.** Stories count floors above grade; finished attics are included.

Source: [ResStock 2025.1 Technical Reference, “Geometry Stories,” Table 11, p. 54](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=66).
